Subject: Pilot economics & context sizing — next steps

Thanks for taking the call today — good discussion. Summary + asks below so we can move to a concrete pilot and pricing sketch.

Quick recap of what I heard from Alex (please correct if I missed anything):
- Primary use case: document summarization + conversational agent inside BrightAI support workspace.
- Approx target rollout: 50k monthly active users in year 1 (pilot subset ~5k).
- Latency SLO: p95 < 1.2s for short completions, okay with slightly higher latency for long context requests.
- Security: SOC2 + VPC option likely required at procurement stage.

What we need to finalize pricing and a pilot budget: please confirm the items below (we'll use these as inputs to the cost model).
1) Monthly request counts (estimates): monthly API calls, rough % of conversational vs batch summarization.
2) Token profile: avg prompt tokens, avg completion tokens, and an approximate distribution for long-context usage (percent of calls needing >8k, >32k, >128k).
3) Target $/1M tokens (ballpark budget number your finance/PM is comfortable with for a pilot).
4) Desired pilot length and success criteria (quality thresholds, latency, and cost targets).

Preliminary economics (back-of-envelope) — please treat as starting point: we assumed a mixed model approach (short-opt model for <8k, long-window variant for >8k) and included caching on summaries. Scenario based on 1M requests / month with the following token mix:
- Avg prompt: 700 tokens
- Avg completion: 1,200 tokens
- Distribution: 76% <2k total, 18% between 2k-8k, 5% between 8k-32k, 1% >32k
Estimated monthly tokens: ~1.9B tokens.
Estimated gross cost (hosted standard models, no committed discount):
- Short mix unit: $1,400 per 1M tokens
- Long-window mix unit: $2,800 per 1M tokens (applies to the 6% long tail in the mix)
Ballpark blended unit: ~$1,560 per 1M tokens => monthly cost ~ $2,964.

If you can confirm the three inputs above, I will: 1) run the workbook to give a 30/90/365 day cost projection, 2) propose a pilot pricing/trial credit structure, and 3) draft a short mutual action plan for procurement.

Attachments I've added for reference:
- brightai_pilot_cost_model_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, assumptions + scenario tabs)
- brightai_mutual_action_plan.docx (proposal + milestones)

Next steps: can you confirm the token profile (avg prompt & completion + % long-context) and procurement timeline by early next week?

Thanks,
Rishi

- Monthly target (initial pilot): 5k users, ~450k requests / month.
- Avg prompt tokens: ~620 tokens (users send a short message + 2–3 system instructions).
- Avg completion tokens: ~950 tokens (summaries + short Q&A).
- Distribution: ~78% <2k, ~16% 2k–8k, ~4% 8k–32k, ~2% >32k (the >32k bucket is mostly our 1–2% weekly long case where we attach multiple docs).
- Preferred pilot length: 60 days.
- Procurement note: finance is aiming for a $/1M target around $1,500 for the pilot (they'd like to see a small committed volume and proof of unit economics before moving to an enterprise commit).

Procurement timeline: initial legal + security review mid-Nov; final approval target Nov 15 if pilot performance looks good. We'll push infra to share a sample token histogram by Monday.

Happy to hop on a quick 30-min follow-up to align the pilot SLA and data-handling requirements.

—Alex

Internal summary and proposed next steps after Alex's numbers:

What Alex confirmed:
- Pilot scope: ~450k requests / month, avg prompt 620, avg completion 950, distribution with ~6% long-context (8k+) and ~2% >32k.
- Budget target: ~$1,500 per 1M tokens for the pilot window.
- Timeline: security/legal initial review mid-Nov, decision target Nov 15.

Our ask to engineering (Karthik): can you validate the following from a serving/cost perspective:
1) If we assume 450k req/month with the distribution above, run model-selection scenarios (short-opt vs long-window) and share a blended unit cost for 30/60/90 day pilots with and without a 20% pilot credit.
2) Confirm if KV caching on summaries reduces completion tokens for repeat queries (we should model a 10–25% effective completion reduction for active users).
3) Any infra constraints for supporting the 2% >32k tail in a short pilot (GPU footprint / queueing considerations).

Proposed commercial approach (draft for review):
- 60-day pilot: 1) fixed monthly baseline of 0.5M requests (to cover burst), 2) bill blended unit at $1,500 per 1M tokens for the pilot with a one-time $2,500 pilot credit to reduce initial sticker shock, 3) evaluate 30-day checkpoint for SLA + quality.
- If engineering confirms caching benefits and blended unit comes down < $1,300 per 1M, propose a bridge program: 3-month discounted commit (15% off) followed by full enterprise pricing.

I've attached the updated cost workbook with the Alex numbers filled in and a placeholder mutual action plan for procurement. Please review and flag anything we should change before I send to Alex.
